narrative.details: We've got to find the source. I've seen a lot more people than usual - guards included - going in and out of The Gilded Rose. Talk to Allison. If she's selling them, she can tell you where they came from.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Innkeeper Allison at The Gilded Rose in Stormwind's Trade District.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh yes, I just got the perfume and cologne in stock recently. It's been selling so well, I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves.

If you ask me, it's kind of boring. Everyone smelling the same? It smells great, but still.
